title: Time-relative flows: the registration warning and the MCP sweepObject advice still treat the start node's objectName as the condition object
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② found by the contract review of PR #30393 (card #30283, record 6654534464, non-blocking notes 1 and 2), outside that card's surface. **Read, not measured** — the first act is to measure it. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:server` — `service-automation` (`flow-registration-checks.ts`) and `packages/mcp` (`mcp-http-tools.ts`, `skill-md.ts`).
Dedupe: `sweepObject objectName time-relative` → none open. **New.**

## What the reading says

A time-relative flow's run binds `timeRelative.object` (the scanned object) and never reads the start node's `objectName`. PR #30393 makes the publish door refuse a start whose `objectName` differs from `timeRelative.object`. Two places still speak as if `objectName` were the condition object:

1. **Registration advisory.** `flow-registration-checks.ts` (~L455–L462 at `d3580892`) types a time-relative flow's conditions against `config.objectName`. A two-object flow stored before PR #30393 keeps an `unknown field` warning at registration for a field that is right for the scanned object, and none for a field that will fail at run time.
2. **MCP advice.** `validate_expression`'s description and its `sweepObject` input text (`mcp-http-tools.ts` ~L1104–L1151), and `skill-md.ts` ~L278–L279, tell an agent to pass `sweepObject` when it differs from `objectName` ("then a mismatch warns"). After PR #30393 that case is a flow the publish door refuses.

## Wanted

- [ ] Measure the registration warning on a stored two-object time-relative flow.
- [ ] Type the registration pass's conditions against the object the binding uses (`timeRelative.object` when it is a string), the same rule as the run.
- [ ] Reword the MCP `sweepObject` text and `skill-md.ts` lines to name the readiness refusal (`flow-time-relative-object-mismatch`), or retire the other-object arm.

Links: #30283, PR #30393, PR #30276.
